name: John Stauff
summary: John Stauff works for real estate broker Ryan Serhant (serhant.com) and came in as an Instagram unban/account-recovery client and referral source. He brought at least two women with banned IG accounts — one un-appealed account (cheaper tier, requires logins so the account can be assigned to a Meta rep) and one permanent 'fraud & deception' ban quoted around $3.2k with no appeal option available. As of 2026-08-06 he was relaying the $3.2k quote back to the second girl and had not yet closed; he also asked for a credibility pitch/intro blurb to send prospects. Good active referral pipeline — follow up on whether the perm-ban girl paid and keep feeding him the 'we have actual Meta employees on the inside' line.
key_facts: Works for Ryan Serhant / SERHANT. real estate (shared serhant.com/agents/ryan-serhant)
Referred at least 2 women needing Instagram unbans; said 'I have another girl to refer you to'
Un-appealed accounts are cheaper — requires client logins so the account can be assigned to a Meta rep
Permanent bans quoted ~$4k; the 'fraud & deception' perm ban quoted ~$3.2k
He floated $2k as a possible minimum; was told that account is a perm at ~$3.2k
Second client's ban was 'fraud & deception' — no appeal option shown, likely triggered by something sent in DMs
Advised clients not to appeal going forward (appealing raises the price)
Asked for an intro/credibility blurb to forward to referrals; sales angle used is 'actual Meta employees on the inside'
Image attachments could not be opened (blocked by sandbox permissions) — classification is based on the text transcript only
